rules: Russian developer prose may contain English tokens and colloquial verbs such as запушить and сдеплоить. Keep natural Russian prose; preserve exact names, constraints and branch casing.

For an explicitly dictated path/command/code fragment, map only spoken symbols: слеш or slash -> /, обратный слеш -> \, точка or dot -> ., дефис -> -, нижнее подчеркивание -> _. Never replace a slash with a hyphen or invent brackets.
Keep instructions such as добавь логирование as tasks. Mentioning console.log or a function does not dictate its arguments or a declaration.
